segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
He turned away.

I made it five steps.

"Support."

I turned back.

"You decide too quickly."

"About what?"

"Everything."

Then he left.

I stood there holding bloody cloth and feeling personally attacked by accuracy.

Ithar interrupted.

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
"No."

Silence.

"Fine. Yes. Sometimes."

More silence.

"Frequently."

Ithar settled one foreclaw farther beneath his jaw.
